# pbs_acl (Data Source)

Reads the access control list of a Proxmox Backup Server: which roles users and API tokens have on which paths. With Sys.Audit on /access/acl it shows every entry; without it, PBS shows only the entries of the API tokens of the user the provider signs in as.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Who has which role on the datastore store1 and on its namespaces.
data "pbs_acl" "store1" {
  path = "/datastore/store1"
}

output "store1_roles" {
  value = [for e in data.pbs_acl.store1.entries : "${e.path}: ${e.auth_id} has ${e.role}"]
}

# The roles of the Proxmox VE cluster's API token, on every path.
data "pbs_acl" "pve_token" {
  auth_id = "pve@pbs!cluster1"
}

output "pve_token_roles" {
  value = { for e in data.pbs_acl.pve_token.entries : e.path => e.role... }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auth_id` (String) Read only the entries of this user ID or API token ID.
- `exact` (Boolean) Read only the entries on `path` itself, not those below it. Requires `path`.
- `path` (String) Read only the entries on this path and, unless `exact` is set, below it, such as `/datastore/store1`. Leave it out for every entry.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) The entries, sorted by path, user or token ID and role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `auth_id` (String) User ID or API token ID the role is granted to.
- `path` (String) ACL path the role applies to.
- `propagate` (Boolean) Whether the role also applies below `path`.
- `role` (String) Role granted.
